source: Original game design. Costs, build times and upkeep are stylised abstractions informed by public procurement figures (e.g. CBO/GAO unit-cost reports, SIPRI Arms Transfers) and are not real-world prices. Symbol codes follow MIL-STD-2525C via the MIT-licensed milsymbol library.

units.name: Infantry Division
units.description: Light formations that hold terrain and benefit most from defensive ground.

units.name: Mechanized Division
units.description: Infantry fighting vehicles and mobile artillery; the workhorse of modern manoeuvre warfare.

units.name: Armoured Division
units.description: Main battle tanks. Strong on plains, weak in mountains and jungle.

units.name: Artillery / Rocket Brigade
units.description: Tube and rocket artillery including precision long-range fires.

units.name: Air Defence Brigade
units.description: Integrated surface-to-air systems that deny enemy air superiority.

units.name: Special Operations Group
units.description: Elite raiders. Can embark on amphibious groups and ignore some terrain penalties.

units.name: Marine Expeditionary Brigade
units.description: Naval infantry trained for landings from amphibious groups.

units.name: Fighter Wing
units.description: Multirole fighters. Contest air superiority over their base region and its neighbours.

units.name: Bomber Wing
units.description: Long-range strike aircraft. Devastating against ground forces when air superiority is held.

units.name: Drone Wing
units.description: Cheap uncrewed strike and reconnaissance systems; scale with drone technology.

units.name: Carrier Strike Group
units.description: A carrier with escorts. Projects air power to adjacent coasts and controls sea zones.

units.name: Destroyer / Frigate Group
units.description: Surface combatants for sea control, air defence and land-attack missiles.

units.name: Attack Submarine Flotilla
units.description: Hunter-killers. Excellent against surface groups, invisible to most sensors.

units.name: Ballistic Missile Submarine
units.description: Second-strike platform. Each one raises the credibility of nuclear deterrence.

units.name: Amphibious Ready Group
units.description: Carries up to two marine or special-operations units for landings on enemy coasts.
